title: LZ77 Window Duel
tagline: Compare encoding cost and compression opportunity across sliding-window and suffix-based LZ77 variants.

curves.label: Naive LZ77 Scan
curves.code: for(pos=0; pos<n; pos++){ bestLen=0; bestDist=0; for(dist=1; dist<=pos; dist++){ l=0; while(pos+l<n && bytes[pos+l]==bytes[pos-dist+l]) l++; if(l>bestLen){bestLen=l;bestDist=dist;} } emit(bestDist,bestLen); }
curves.name: Naive LZ77 Scan

curves.label: Hashed 3-gram Chains
curves.code: index= new Map(); for(pos=0; pos<n; pos++){ key=hash(bytes[pos],bytes[pos+1]||0,bytes[pos+2]||0); candidates=index.get(key)||[]; bestLen=0; bestDist=0; for(c of candidates){ l=match(bytes,pos,c); if(l>bestLen){bestLen=l;bestDist=pos-c;} } candidates.push(pos); index.set(key,candidates.slice(-16)); emit(bestDist,bestLen); }
curves.name: Hashed 3-gram Chains

bwt = buildBWT(bytes); ctable=countChars(bwt); occ=buildOcc(bwt); for(pos=0; pos<n; pos++){ // backward extend match using LF-mapping
l=0; state=initState(pos); while(canExtend(state,bwt,bytes,pos+l)){ state=LF(state, bytes[pos+l]); l++; } bestDist=deriveDistanceFromState(state); emit(bestDist,l); }
